summary.text: Larry Alwin is the Democratic candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 28, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Allen Hogg (R) is also on the ballot.
Alwin advanced from the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary as a write-in candidate.

paragraphs.text: Larry Alwin was also the Democratic candidate for Wyoming House of Representatives District 28 in 2024, when incumbent John Winter (R) won the general election with 82.1 percent of the vote to Alwin's 17.7 percent.
Ballotpedia lists his 2024 campaign contributions at $4,609 and expenditures at $4,188.
Alwin signed the U.S. Term Limits Pledge, according to Ballotpedia.
